children: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Commerce recalled 391 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Grand Cherokee L vehicles due to a fault in the tire pressure monitoring system.
According to the ministry, the fault may prevent warning indicators from appearing when tire pressure drops, increasing the risk of an accident.

Owners were urged to check whether their vehicle identification number (VIN) is included in the recall through Recalls.sa and contact Petromin Stellantis to have the necessary updates carried out free of charge.
Affected vehicle owners can contact Petromin Stellantis at 8003030040.
